name: search_rackets
description: Find tennis rackets from the Baseline Tennis catalog that fit the shopper's budget and skill level, ranked with their preferred playing style first. Returns product details only; it does NOT say whether anything is in stock. Call this before recommending any racket.

max_price.description: The shopper's maximum budget in US dollars, e.g. 150.

playing_style.description: Preferred playing style. Omit if the shopper has no preference.
